newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: St George Bank to issue US$100 mln TLCs.
newsitem.headline: St George Bank to issue US$100 mln TLCs.

text.p: St George Bank Ltd said it will issue US$100 million in five-year transferable loan certificates (TLCs).
St George said it signed documentation in Singapore on Thursday for its eighth issue of TLCs.
It said it received commitments from nine international banks for US$100 million of new TLCs which will mature on June 12, 2002.
The coupon on the issue has been set at LIBOR plus 12 basis points for the five years.
With fees, the total return to investors will be 14.5 or 15 basis points, depending on the participation amount.
The TLCs will be issued under St. George's Debt Instrument Programme dated June 21, 1994.
The issue is being arranged by BT Australia (HK) Financial Services Ltd, St George said.
When drawn down on June 20, the proceeds of the issue will partially refinance other maturing TLCs.
